subject: Security sync: SOC 2 / Pen test / DPA — overnight runway scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Zhou <alex.zhou@finflow.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: securityops@finflow.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security sync request — SOC 2 / pen test / DPA

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. We're ready to lock in a joint session to run through SOC 2 scope, the DPA draft, and pen-test logistics. Our security folks are in APAC (AEST) and prefer late-evening / overnight windows US West time — avoids disrupting our ops.

High level ask: one session (90 minutes) covering control mapping, evidence handoff (SFTP or secure SharePoint), and pen-test scoping so we can confirm vendor access.

Two constraints from our side:
- We need an attendee from your side who can speak to runtime/evidence retention (ops/infra).
- Please include a DPA point of contact so legal can quickly redline the draft.

Preferred dates (we're flexible):
- Option A: 2025-07-07 04:00–05:30 AEST (2025-07-06 11:00–12:30 PDT)
- Option B: 2025-07-08 01:00–02:30 AEST (2025-07-07 20:00–21:30 PDT)

If you can propose equivalent US-West overnight windows and confirm who will be on the call from Redwood, we'll pick one and send calendar invites.

I've attached our internal inventory (controls list) to help prep.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Zhou
Head of Security Operations, Finflow
security@finflow.com
Attachment: Finflow-Control-Inventory.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Zhou <alex.zhou@finflow.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security sync request — SOC 2 / pen test / DPA

Alex — thanks for the context and the inventory. Overnight windows make sense; we can run the session as an "overnight runway" and include the right ops/infra and legal contacts.

Quick proposal from our side (converted to both time zones):
- Option 1 (earlier APAC): 2025-07-07 04:00–05:30 AEST / 2025-07-06 11:00–12:30 PDT
- Option 2 (later APAC): 2025-07-08 01:00–02:30 AEST / 2025-07-07 20:00–21:30 PDT

Attendees (Redwood):
- Hannah Schmitt — Security & Compliance (host)
- Ben Carter — SOC 2 / Controls runbook (ops)
- Marissa Cole — Customer Success (onboarding flow + evidence transfer)

Agenda (90 min):
1) 10 min introductions & scope (SOC 2 in-scope systems, retention)
2) 30 min control map review (we'll open the SOC2-Control-Map)
3) 25 min pen-test access & vendor checklist (RedSeal oncall?)
4) 15 min DPA items & next steps (DocuSign / redlines)
5) 10 min wrap / owner assignments

Attachments I am sending now: SOC2-Control-Map.pdf (summary of mapped controls) and a DPA draft for legal to review (DPA-draft-Redwood.docx). If Finflow prefers SFTP evidence vs SharePoint, note that in your reply and we'll include the ops runbook for transfer.

If either option works, I'll send a calendar invite with a +30 minute buffer for prep and include a short dry-run checklist.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
(hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai)
Attachments: SOC2-Control-Map.pdf (pdf); DPA-draft-Redwood.docx (docx)
